headline: hook
source: Source: AAA Thanksgiving travel forecast (Nov 24–30, 2026), published Nov 2026
benchmarks: ftA18KGBrwM — kichik raqamdan kosmik miqyosga pog'ona (1 in 4 → Yer atrofida 3 marta), har pog'ona o'z tasviri
8Sp2jBDdTDM — paradoks burilish: 'rekordga o'xshaydi, aslida PASAYISH' (0–3 s hook + oxirida burilish)
DfC5DUuTroA — YANGI: tirik kurka lavhasi ustida quruq zarba ('the turkey should fly ME') — masshtab/rol kontrasti, oldingi 5 videoda yo'q

scenes.text: 81.5 million Americans are about to leave home. Same week.
scenes.say: [excited] Eighty-one and a half million Americans are about to leave home. Same week.
scenes.head: 81.5 MILLION AMERICANS. ONE WEEK.

scenes.text: That's roughly one in four people in the whole country.
scenes.say: That's roughly one in four people in the whole country.

scenes.text: Line them up holding hands... they'd wrap around the Earth three times.
scenes.say: Line them up holding hands... they'd wrap around the Earth three times.
scenes.show_source: Our math: 81.5M × ~1.5 m arm span ≈ 122,000 km; Earth ≈ 40,075 km around

scenes.say: Seventy-two point nine million of them? Driving.

scenes.text: Into gas at $3.82 a gallon. Last year it was $3.08.
scenes.say: Into gas at three eighty-two a gallon. Last year it was three oh eight.
scenes.show_source: AAA national average, regular, Nov 16, 2025 vs Nov 16, 2026

scenes.text: Flying? AAA's average round trip: $800. Up 17%.
scenes.say: Flying? Triple A's average round trip: eight hundred dollars. Up seventeen percent.
scenes.show_source: AAA bookings, domestic round trip, Thanksgiving 2026 vs 2025

scenes.text: For $800, the turkey should be flying ME.
scenes.say: [deadpan] For eight hundred bucks, the turkey should be flying ME.

scenes.text: And here's the twist. This is a DROP. The first in three years.
scenes.say: And here's the twist... this is a DROP. The first in three years.
scenes.show_source: AAA forecast: 81.5M vs ~81.6M in 2025; ends three straight record years

scenes.text: About 121,000 people decided the trip just wasn't worth it.
scenes.say: About a hundred twenty-one thousand people decided the trip just wasn't worth it.

scenes.text: So... are you driving, flying, or staying home this year?
scenes.say: So... are you driving, flying, or staying home this year?
scenes.show_source: Forecast, not final numbers — AAA, Nov 2026
